result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly around content being obscured or appearing stuck in a loading state.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant card content is already visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading overlay is dismissed once the image or card data has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/loading state before the card appears.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant list content. The next restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed tab bar at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not covered by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Horizontally scrollable sections, such as the category chips and 'Fastest near you' cards, are clipped at the right edge without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: If this is intentional, consider adding subtle spacing, fade treatment, or ensuring partially visible items look intentionally scrollable rather than cut off.
